dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Prominent, high-contrast white bands and terminal spots provide a sharp, jagged boundary against dark gray flight feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Indistinct; the gray plumage is continuous and uniform from the crown through the nape to the mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: A small, high-contrast red patch is visible on the anterior portion of the crown.
